source_acquisition.search_note: PDF p.1 explicitly links https://github.com/SLGSP/CCR. gh repo view confirms SLGSP/CCR on main; README contains only “# CCR” and “Code is coming soon~”, and the recursive main tree has README.md only. No plot*, figure*, visual*, table*, .ipynb, .tex, .tikz, .pgf, .svg, style, or data file exists. Local corpus/visual_sources/icml-2026-9cf70f22a7ed/ is absent; full-title/method/arXiv/OpenReview GitHub searches found no direct alternative visual source. All visual facts therefore come from the PDF.

paper_style.palette_strategy: Figure 1–2 use pastel mechanism colors; Figure 3/7 use a stable five-role categorical palette (SRe²L, D⁴M, ROME, C²R and whole-dataset reference); Figure 5/6 use local categorical palettes; Tables 1–9 use black/gray plus blue relative-improvement text, while Table 10 is grayscale.
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: Captions, table text/rules and some diagram elements are PDF vector objects. Figure 3–7 result charts and Figure 4 image tiles are embedded raster; Figure 1–2 combine vector labels/arrows with raster or image components. The mix is established by 200 dpi rendering and pdfimages inspection; no source file was available.
paper_style.style_consistency: Nimbus Roman/Times and Computer Modern math are stable across paper text, captions and tables; raster charts introduce Times New Roman/Arial-like labels. Figure 3/7 and Tables 1/5/6, 2/8/9 are intentionally isomorphic, while palette semantics are local rather than globally unified.

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. Existing robust DD struggles to balance robustness and accuracy by (i) ignoring that robust risk is driven by the smallest margins and (ii) failing to separate classes near decision boundaries. C²R addresses this with an attack-aware curriculum that prioritizes small-margin adversaries and a contrastive robustness loss.

color.semantic_mapping: 红色 Robustness、蓝色 Accuracy，黄/橙和粉色标出 failure/solution，灰色与浅色填充表示风险区、数据集和模块。

figures.data_and_statistics: 概念流程图；caption 给出 smallest margins、boundary separation 和两个方法组件，但图面没有样本聚合、分母、数值不确定性或实验单位。
figures.evidence_relation: 摘要的 robustness–accuracy tension → Figure 1 的问题几何与方法入口 → §4 的 AAC/CRL、Eq. (6)–(9) → Figure 2、Table 3 以及 Tables 1–9 的实证闭合。
design_strengths: 将问题诊断、方法组件和数据流置于一张图内。
箭头、直接标签、颜色和样本图标提供部分冗余。

figures.reusable_pattern: 先用“问题几何 → 方法接口”概念图定义机制，再让后续图表分别绑定排序、边界损失和结果。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2. Overview of the proposed C²R framework. LS-PGD generates adversarial examples and assigns perturbation scores to form an attack-aware curriculum (AAC), while the synthetic dataset is iteratively optimized with a supervised loss and a contrastive robustness loss (CRL) that aligns clean–adversarial features and enlarges the robust decision margin.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 diagnoses smallest-margin and boundary failure; Figure 2 turns that diagnosis into AAC/CRL interfaces; Tables 1–2 establish main accuracy; Figure 3 gives PGD drop rate; Figure 4 gives qualitative images; Figure 5 gives accuracy–time; Figure 6 gives η/component sensitivity; Tables 3–4 bind ablations and cost; Tables 5–9 extend epsilon/AutoAttack/FGSM/ImageNet coverage; Table 10 tests distribution shifts.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure captions describe mechanism or state the main DR finding, while table captions primarily define metric, datasets, IPC, epsilon/attack, color emphasis and five-run aggregation. Figure 5 bubble size and Figure 6 default-selection interpretation remain partly in body text.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Tables 1–2 and 5–9 use dataset-group→IPC subheaders and method-group→attack rows; Table 10 uses dataset-group→RDD/C²R. This makes replicated robustness slices comparable but pushes wide tables toward small type.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 LS-PGD/AAC/CRL interfaces map to Table 3 four-way component ablation, Table 4 LS-PGD speedup, Figure 5 cost plot, Figure 6 η scan and Figure 4 qualitative evidence; Tables 1–2/5–9 and Figure 3/7 carry the main robustness outcomes.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Figure 3 PGD and Tables 1–2 are extended by Figure 7 FGSM and Tables 5–9 at epsilon 4/255, 8/255, AutoAttack and ImageNet subsets; Table 10 adds distribution shifts. Appendix A Algorithm 1 is a reproducibility interface, not a visual object; Appendices D–E state transfer and margin-measurement limits.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF object text is consistently Nimbus Roman/Times with Computer Modern math; charts are rasterized with a Times/Arial-like sublanguage. Caption hierarchy, two-column placement and table rules remain stable, but chart labels and wide table cells are near the small-print threshold.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Figure 3 and Figure 7 share method/reference colors, and Tables 1/5/6 and 2/8/9 share emphasis conventions. Figure 1/2, Figure 5/6 and Table 10 use local palettes; blue improvement text and red reference lines are semantically useful but the overall paper is not globally palette-consistent or fully grayscale-safe.

most_reusable_patterns: Conceptual problem geometry followed by a two-container method pipeline and matched ablation/main-comparison objects.
Isomorphic dataset→IPC table headers and Figure 3/7 multi-panel grammar for attack-budget or attack-type extensions.
Adjacent performance, cost and component objects (Figure 5, Figure 6, Table 3, Table 4) that expose mechanism-to-decision trade-offs.
Captions that define units, IPC, epsilon, attacks, reference lines and five-run aggregation; table cells retain relative gains alongside absolute accuracy.
failure_patterns: Very wide tables and dense point annotations push type toward the small-print threshold.
Explicitly averaged result tables have no dispersion or inferential uncertainty, and the plotted results have no error encoding.
Figure 4 lacks sampling/blind-scoring rules, Figure 5 lacks complete hardware/timing protocol, and high-budget near-zero cells lack failure notation.
The public author repository has no plot or table source, so PDF rendering cannot be checked against exact plotting parameters; several charts are not fully grayscale-safe.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: The paper starts with a smallest-margin/boundary diagnosis, instantiates it as an AAC/CRL pipeline, and closes the robust-DD claim through isomorphic cross-attack tables, drop-rate panels, cost and ablation views, while leaving uncertainty, qualitative sampling rules and public visual source code under-specified.
